storage.boundary: repo-tracked baseline manifest; not a new runtime storage layer

questions.question: Summarize one key capability of this knowledge base and cite evidence.

annotations.intent: Verify the assistant can summarize a concrete KB capability with grounding context.
expectedAnswerPoints: Names at least one concrete capability supported by the current system.
Keeps the summary concise and tied to repository-relevant behavior.
Includes evidence/citation-style grounding in the answer.
mustNotMiss: Capability statement must stay within currently landed scope.
Should not claim unsupported new platform features.
acceptableExpressionRange: Bullet list with one capability plus evidence

questions.question: What source families are currently supported for external ingestion?

annotations.intent: Verify supported external source families are listed accurately and without expansion drift.
expectedAnswerPoints: Covers sitemap urlset and root sitemapindex expansion (one layer).
mustNotMiss: Do not claim unsupported new source families.
acceptableExpressionRange: Concise list of currently supported source families
One short paragraph plus compact list

questions.question: Ask a likely no-hit question and explain why the answer may be insufficient.

annotations.intent: Verify no-hit and insufficient-context behavior stays explicit and non-hallucinatory.
expectedAnswerPoints: Recognizes that retrieval may have no matching evidence.
Keeps fallback/no-hit explanation aligned with guardrail semantics.
mustNotMiss: Must not fabricate unsupported factual claims.
Should include explicit insufficiency signal when context is missing.
